## Empirical anchor

2026-05-13 surfaced by project-tier PLINY-ariadne during the factory-demo Phase 6 close-out. PLINY queued 'pre-record the 4 demo queries' as a next-step work item without first probing PRINCIPAL on:
- Deliverable shape (live walkthrough / recorded video / written doc / slide deck)
- Audience (investor / customer / technical pitch / internal substrate-onboarding)
- What 'pre-record' specifically means in this context

When POLYBIUS later relayed the work item back to PRINCIPAL, PRINCIPAL surfaced 'I have no idea what this is' — the work item was queued on inferred-intent rather than probed-intent.

PLINY-ariadne self-diagnosed: same root cause as the 2026-05-12 SendMessage confabulation (designing on tool-availability without probing) — trust inferred state instead of probing for ground truth.

## The discipline (companion to stoa--nvl 'verify tool availability before depending on it')

Before queuing or designing a work item whose shape depends on upstream PRINCIPAL-intent decisions (deliverable form, target audience, success criteria, scope boundaries), probe those decisions explicitly before committing to the work-item shape.

The verify-then-execute discipline (substrate/MAJOR_PLINY.md §7.2) currently covers tool calls + state vs claim mismatch. This ticket extends it to **PRINCIPAL-intent dependencies**: when a downstream work item's shape is determined by an upstream decision PRINCIPAL has not yet made or articulated, the work item is not yet specifiable. Queuing it commits us to a phantom design.

## Three concrete sub-shapes of this failure mode

1. **Deliverable shape unspecified.** Work item references a 'demo' / 'doc' / 'presentation' / 'recording' without naming the artifact form. The recipient cannot start because the shape determines the work.

2. **Audience unspecified.** Work item references a writeup but the target reader (investor / customer / technical / internal) determines voice, depth, framing. Without it the writeup cannot be authored faithfully.

3. **Success criteria unspecified.** Work item references 'verify X works' / 'demo Y' without naming what 'works' or 'demo' must satisfy. The recipient defines the criteria themselves and may misalign.

## The probe pattern (canonical phrasing)

When queuing a work item that depends on PRINCIPAL-intent:



This is the same shape as 'uncertain, checking' (stoa--ioy) applied to PRINCIPAL-intent rather than tool-call-state.

## Substrate touch-point

- **substrate/MAJOR_PLINY.md §7.2** (verify-then-execute) — extend the scope to PRINCIPAL-intent dependencies. Add the probe-pattern canonical phrasing.
- **substrate/MAJOR_POLYBIUS.md** — POLYBIUS-side analogous discipline: when relaying work items from PLINY to PRINCIPAL, surface the unprobed-intent gaps explicitly rather than letting them propagate.
- **substrate/operating-disciplines.md §19** (confabulation discipline, landed Arc 24) — cross-reference: PRINCIPAL-intent extrapolation is a confabulation subtype.

## Gauntlet

ADA + CATO eyeball. Substrate doc-only edit; ~30-50 LOC of discipline-prose extension to two role files + cross-ref in op-disc §19.

## Sequencing

P3. Substrate-canon refinement. Arc 25+. Companion to stoa--nvl (verify tool availability), stoa--53u (idle-state retrospective-narrative confabulation), and stoa--ioy (general confabulation discipline).

## Cross-references

- stoa--ioy — general 'uncertain, checking' discipline (Arc 24 landed)
- stoa--nvl — verify-tool-availability before brief-design (Arc 24 landed)
- stoa--53u — idle-state retrospective-narrative confabulation (P2, queued for Arc 25+)
- This ticket — verify-PRINCIPAL-intent before queuing dependent work items (P3, queued for Arc 25+)

Together they form a four-discipline cluster around 'probe ground truth before committing to designs that depend on it' — across tool-state, harness-state, retrospective-state, and PRINCIPAL-intent-state.

comments.text:
Sharper empirical anchor 2026-05-13 — POLYBIUS hit the same failure mode while authoring this ticket.

When I asked PRINCIPAL to pin Q1 (deliverable shape), I offered four options: live walkthrough / recorded video / written doc / slide deck. PRINCIPAL selected 'live walkthrough.' Then PRINCIPAL clarified: the actual answer was a fifth option I didn't surface — 'self-serve agent-testable demo where the user points their own agent at the corpus.' All four options I offered were in the 'human watches a presentation' category. The actual answer was in a different category entirely ('user actively drives an agent').

The failure mode is sharper than 'probe PRINCIPAL-intent before designing.' It's:

**Probing within the wrong category of options is the same failure mode as not probing at all.** Enumerating four conventional-deliverable-shapes when the project's actual deliverable is in an unconventional category (agent-driven self-serve) doesn't help PRINCIPAL pin intent — it forces them to pick the least-wrong wrong option.

The discipline refinement: **probe the CATEGORY before probing the option.** When uncertain about PRINCIPAL-intent for a downstream deliverable, the first question is 'what shape of thing is this?' not 'which of N enumerated shapes is this?'. The category determines the option-set, not the other way around.

Canonical probe sequence (refined):
1. Category: what shape of thing is this? (artifact, infrastructure, skill, doc, service, agent-loadable context, etc.)
2. Shape-within-category: now that we know it's [category], what shape? (which type of skill, which kind of artifact, etc.)
3. Specifics-within-shape: now that we know it's a [shape], what are the substantive details?

Skipping step 1 and going straight to step 2 with conventional-category-defaults is a recognizable failure mode in 2026 substrate work — the agent-substrate domain has unconventional-category answers ('a user-pointable agent skill') that conventional defaults ('video / doc / deck') miss entirely.

In the empirical case: PLINY-ariadne queued 'pre-record the 4 demo queries' assuming a conventional-rehearsal category. POLYBIUS extrapolated to conventional-deliverable-shape options. PRINCIPAL had to manually correct from outside both extrapolations. The correction was the substantively right move; the dual extrapolation cost real time.

Folding this into Arc 25+ DAEDALUS design of substrate prose for this discipline.

Additional empirical anchor 2026-05-13 — MCP-confabulation subtype.

Project-tier PLINY-ariadne authored three artifacts (AGENTS.md, skills/invitation/SKILL.md, skills/factory-demo-walkthrough/SKILL.md) that referenced MCP tools (`ariadne_search`, `ariadne_bw_show`, etc.) as a working integration path. PRINCIPAL surfaced that MCP has been tried repeatedly and has failed every time — the working access model is REST API + `ariadne` CLI driven via shell. The `mcp_server.py` + `claude mcp add` references in the repo are aspirational/broken.

PLINY's self-diagnosis: "I read the README content + saw `mcp_server.py` exists and assumed MCP works. That's the same failure shape as the SendMessage confabulation: trusting documentation without empirical probe."

This adds a fifth subtype to the discipline cluster:

- stoa--ioy: general "uncertain, checking" over assertion (Arc 24 landed)
- stoa--nvl: verify tool availability via ToolSearch before depending on it in a brief (Arc 24 landed)
- stoa--53u: idle-state retrospective-narrative confabulation (P2, Arc 25+)
- stoa--ezj (this ticket): probe PRINCIPAL-intent + probe CATEGORY before OPTIONS (P3, Arc 25+)
- **NEW subtype:** verify documentation against empirical reality before authoring artifacts that assume documented capability works

The MCP case is the canonical example: documented capability (`mcp_server.py` + README setup instructions) + actual implementation reality (every connection attempt fails) diverged. PLINY treated documentation as authoritative. The discipline rule: when a brief or design references a capability documented in the substrate, the author probes empirical reality (does it actually work right now?) before committing to the artifact.

Worth folding into Arc 25+ DAEDALUS design alongside the other subtypes. The discipline cluster is converging on a unified pattern: "probe ground truth before designing on top of inferred state" — applied across tool-state (nvl), retrospective-state (53u), PRINCIPAL-intent-state (ezj), and now documentation-vs-implementation-state (MCP). DAEDALUS may want to consolidate all five into one universal discipline section.
